title: Minimum Island
whyGoodFit: The mirror image of Max Area of Island: flood-fill each island, measure its size, keep the smallest. Reinforces returning counts from a grid DFS with zero added complexity.
statement:
You are given a grid of characters where `'W'` is water and `'L'` is land.

An island is a group of `'L'` cells connected up, down, left, or right (not diagonally).

Return the size (number of cells) of the SMALLEST island in the grid.

You may assume the grid has at least one island.

examples.explanation: There are two islands: {(0,1),(1,1)} with size 2, and {(2,2)} with size 1. The smallest size is 1.
All three L cells connect into a single island of size 3, so the smallest (and only) island size is 3.

constraints: There is at least one 'L' cell
